segments.text: Commander of the 11th Special Walking Armour Training Battalion.
The protagonist of this story.
Known as a “hero” among Armour pilots, because three years ago, during the great battle, he was one of the seven pilots to take the world’s first Walking Weapons into actual combat.
(At that time, he was the only pilot who was not a head of one of the Rokukyō Families.)
Even now, he continues to travel between training duties and the battlefield with Kotetsu, the very first prototype unit.
Having grown up in a military environment from as early as he can remember, he is poor at dealing with women outside the battlefield.
“For the sake of the Imperial State, I would not hesitate to lay down my life.”
From official website
特歩１１教導大隊の隊長。本作の主人公。
甲冑乗り達から「英雄」と言われている。理由は、３年前の会戦において、世界で初めて実戦投入された７機の歩行兵器の搭乗者の１人であったから。
（当時、六響家当主以外の人間では唯一の搭乗者だった）
現在も最初の実機である「小鉄」をもって教導任務と戦場の地を往来している。
物心ついた時からの軍人環境のせいで、戦場以外での女性との交流は苦手。
特歩11教導大隊の隊長。 本作の主人公。
兵士たちから “英雄” と言われている。
理由は、3年前の会戦において、世界で初めて実戦投入された7機の歩行兵器の搭乗者の1人であったから。
（当時、六響家当主以外の人間では唯一の搭乗者だった）
現在も最初の実機である 『小鉄』 をもって、教導任務と戦場の地を往来している。
物心付いた時からの軍人環境のせいで、戦場以外での女性との交流は苦手。
A subordinate of the protagonist, entrusted with command of a squad.
She pilots a precision-type Walking Tank, specializing in close- and mid-range combat that makes use of its strong defensive capabilities.
Raised as the “Princess of the Hōjō Family”, one of the Rokukyō Families that stand as symbols of the Imperial State’s power and might.
Earnest and straightforward by nature, she often takes things at face value.
Her sensitivity, however, is often seen as a “weakness” by others.
Towards the protagonist, her commanding officer, she harbours feelings that go beyond mere respect for a superior.
“I want to be the shield that protects you.”
From official website
搭乗機：「四○式精密甲冑」
主人公の部下であり分隊を任されている。
精密型の歩行戦車を扱っており防御力を生かした、近、中距離からの打撃戦を得意としている。
皇国の武力と権力の象徴である六響家のうちの「北条家の姫」として育った。
実直な性格で言われたことをそのまま鵜呑みにしてしまう事が多い。
感受性が強く、その事を「弱さ」として見られがちである。
部隊長の主人公に対して、上官に向ける気持ち以上のものを抱いている。
「私は、あなたを守る盾になりたい、です。」
主人公の部下であり小隊を任されている。
精密型の歩行戦車を扱っており、防御力を活かした近・中距離からの打撃戦を得意としている。
皇国の武力と権力の象徴である六響家の “北条家の姫” として育った。
実直な性格で、言われたことをそのまま鵜呑みにしてしまうことが多い。
感受性が強く、そのことを “弱さ” として見られがちでもある。
部隊長の主人公に対して、上官に向ける気持ち以上のものを抱いている。
「私は、あなたを守る盾になりたい、です。」
The deputy commander of the Training Battalion led by the protagonist, and a company commander who pilots a multi-legged unit.
She excels in long-range combat that makes full use of heavy artillery.

Belonging to the Uesugi Family of the Rokukyō Clans, renowned for valuing martial strength above all, she strives to be an outstanding soldier herself, which also makes her harshly critical of the actions of others.
Strong-willed and stubborn, she rarely bends her opinions, and often clashes with the protagonist.
“For blood and honour, I fight for my homeland!”
From official website
主人公が率いる教導大隊の副官であり多脚型の機体を扱う分隊指揮官。
長距離砲を生かした戦いを得意としている。
六響家の中でも「武」の力を尊ぶ上杉家にあり、自らも進んで優秀な軍人であろうとしているため、他人の行動についても厳しい目で見てしまう。
しっかりもので強がりな性格。自分の意見をなかなか曲げず主人公と衝突する事もある。
「血と名誉を示す為、祖国の為、戦います。」
主人公が率いる教導大隊の副官であり、多脚型の機体を扱う。
長距離砲を活かした戦いを得意としている。
六響家の中でも “武” の力を尊ぶ上杉家にあり、自らも進んで優秀な軍人であろうとしているため、他人の行動についても厳しい目で見てしまう。
しっかり者で強がりな性格。 自分の意見をなかなか曲げず、主人公と衝突することもある。
「血と名誉をかけて、祖国の為、戦います。」
Likewise a platoon commander in the Training Battalion.
She skilfully handles a bipedal Walking Tank, specializing in hit-and-run tactics and disruption that make full use of its mobility.
Heir apparent to the Shimazu Family, one of the southern military houses of the Imperial State.
From early childhood, she was placed in an elite academy and subjected to rigorous training for the battlefield.
Because of her eccentric behaviour and words, few within the military truly understand her.
Amid this, she feels a special fondness for the protagonist, who is able to communicate with her — though she herself is unaware of these feelings.
“What am I going to do? I’m so much of a genius, it scares even me.”
From official website
搭乗機：「四○式二足甲冑」
同じく、教導大隊の分隊長。
二足型の歩行戦車を巧みに扱い機動力を生かした撹乱と、一撃離脱攻撃を得意としている。
皇国本土における南方の軍閥、島津響家の次期当主。
幼年から英才施設へ預けられ、戦場での徹底した教育を施されている。
奇抜な言動が目立つため、軍内で彼女を理解出来る人間は少ない。
そんな中で、意志疎通のできる主人公に、好意を抱きつつも彼女自身にその自覚は無い。
「どうしよう。天才過ぎて自分が怖い。」
北条綾子少尉と同じく、教導大隊の小隊長。
二足型の歩行戦車を巧みに扱い、機動力を活かした撹乱と一撃離脱攻撃を得意としている。
皇国本土における南方の軍閥・島津響家の次期当主。
幼年から英才施設へ預けられ、戦場での徹底した教育を施されている。
奇抜な言動が目立つため、軍内で彼女を理解出来る人間は少ない。
そんな中で、意志疎通のできる主人公に好意を抱きつつも、彼女自身にその自覚は無い。
「どうしよう。天才過ぎて自分が怖い。」
Commander of the brigade to which the protagonist’s Training Battalion is assigned.
Hayakawa’s superior officer.
Although her brigade belongs to the Army, it also responds to requests from the military power of the Rokukyō Families.
Arimura is not only politically adept but also brilliant in both strategy and tactics, and as a result, has many enemies.
However, her true achievement lies in her terrifying genius as a developer — the very talent that brought Walking Weapons to completion.
Because of this, there are rumours that she is, in some way, lacking as a person.
According to the protagonist: “In the presence of General Arimura, I feel a kind of tension I have rarely experienced.”
At times she shows neither smile nor anger, and at other times she speaks with a warmth far greater than necessary — two sides that are always intertwined.
Including indirect connections, she has known the protagonist for a long time, and acknowledges his abilities as a soldier.
“If you truly wish to change, then come with me.”
From official website
搭乗機：登録情報無し
主人公の教導大隊が所属する旅団の司令官。
早川の上官。彼女の旅団は、陸軍に所属しながら六響家の軍閥戦力からの要望にもこたえる。政治的だけでなく戦略、戦術においても優秀すぎるので敵が多い。
ただし、本当の功績は、歩行兵器を完成させる程の開発者としての恐るべき才能にある。
そのせいか、どこか欠落している部分もあると噂される。主人公いわく「有村閣下を前にすると、あまり味わった事のない緊張感を覚える」
笑顔も怒りも全く人に見せない時と。必要以上にとても親しげに話す時が常に表裏一体。直接的でない期間も含め、主人公との付き合いは長く、彼の軍人としての能力を認めている。
「変わりたいのなら、私と共に来い。」
主人公の教導大隊が所属する旅団の司令官。 早川の上官。
彼女の旅団は、陸軍に所属しながら六響家の軍閥戦力からの要望にも応える。
政治的だけでなく戦略・戦術においても優秀すぎるので敵が多い。
ただし本当の功績は、歩行兵器を完成させるほどの開発者としての恐るべき才能にある。
そのせいか、どこか欠落している部分もあると噂される。
主人公曰く 「有村閣下を前にすると、あまり味わったことのない緊張感を覚える」
笑顔も怒りもまったく人に見せない時と、必要以上にとても親しげに話す時が、常に表裏一体。
直接的でない期間も含め主人公との付き合いは長く、彼の軍人としての能力を認めている。
「変わりたいのなら、私と共に来い。」
Once a princess of a small kingdom, she lost her homeland in childhood when it was annexed during an invasion by the Empire of Ivan.

During the First Mizuho–Ivan War three years ago, she took part in the campaign as the Emperor’s appointed overseer, leading the Imperial Guard Division alongside the commander chosen by the nobility. However, when that commander rashly launched an attack on their own, the battle situation collapsed, forcing the Empire into an untimely withdrawal.
Following the war, the commander was dismissed and Varvara was appointed in their place as commander of the Eastern Expeditionary Army.
“Forgive me. I must burden you with a harsh duty.”
From official website
楓和の前に現れた謎の美少女。
自らを「時空を司る神」と名乗り、楓和に魔法少女の力を授けるとともに、異世界からの侵略者である触手生命体と戦うように伝える。
楓和たちには辛辣な言葉遣いながらも様々なアドバイス、手助けをしてくれる。
ただし、『神』である以上、地球人だけに加担するわけにはいかないため、
戦闘に直接参加する事は許されない。
楓和の前に現れた謎の美少女。
自らを「時空を司る神」と名乗り、楓和に魔法少女の力を授けるとともに、
異世界からの侵略者である触手生命体と戦うように伝える。
楓和たちには辛辣な言葉遣いながらも様々なアドバイス、手助けをしてくれる。
ただし、『神』である以上、地球人だけに加担するわけにはいかないため、
戦闘に直接参加する事は許されない。
Among the cadets, she was recognized as having the greatest potential and was assigned to Hayakawa’s unit.
She pilots a Precision-type and excels at base assaults.
She is a self-proclaimed and widely acknowledged Walking Tank fanatic and has earned the nickname “Walking Tank Encyclopedia”.
Her boundless energy is her strong point, but because she is far too honest about her own desires, she often runs out of control.
She frequently clashes with her classmate Yuuhi due to their mismatched personalities.
She harbours an extraordinary crush on Kotetsu, the machine piloted by the protagonist.
“In the Major’s unit, even I get a chance to touch Kotetsu!?”
From official website
A mysterious girl who bears an uncanny resemblance to Rurinomikoto.
Born deaf, she is unable to speak.
She communicates through sign language.
From official website
She belongs to a different battalion than the protagonist.
Although she pilots a precision-type unit, she does not carry a shield.
Instead, she wields a massive hammer, favouring a reckless, assault-oriented combat style.
A true battle maniac, she feels pure joy in the act of fighting.
She only recognizes value in strength. If she deems someone to be weak, even if they are a superior officer, she will bare her fangs without hesitation.
She harbours a twisted sense of admiration for the protagonist, whose strength borders on the heroic.
“That presence… yes. Very good. Excellent.”
From official website
The mechanic in charge of maintaining the battalion’s Walking Tanks under the protagonist’s command.
Though her innocent, childlike manner often stands out, her undeniable skills as a mechanic have earned her the deep trust of the battalion.
On the other hand, her love for the machines borders on excessive; should anyone— even the protagonist himself—handle her beloved Walking Tanks carelessly, she will lash out without hesitation.
Her favourite food is the rice balls the protagonist prepares for her.
“If you don’t call me Momo-chan, I won’t be able to give you my reports.”
From official website
One of the cadets, later assigned to the protagonist’s unit.
She specializes in long-range artillery, steadily cornering her targets.
Though she possesses no special powers, she carries a powerful flamethrower as her trump card.
Born into a distinguished family, she is very much a refined young lady.
Among the cadets she boasts the highest marks, but her constant drive to aim ever higher gives her a tendency to look down on others.
Nevertheless, she respects the protagonist, who, despite being of common birth, commands even the daughters of the Rokukyō Families.
“I will surely become the Major’s right hand.”
From official website
Like Kimiko and Shinobu, she went through the cadet program before being assigned to Hayakawa’s unit.
She pilots a bipedal Walking Tank, often serving as part of the vanguard.
Coming from an ordinary household, she lacks the standout abilities possessed by many of the other cadets.
Her gentle and timid disposition is a weakness, though she tries to mask it with forced cheerfulness, always striving to encourage those around her.
Yet her personality, ill-suited to war, together with the excellence of her comrades in the unit, weighs heavily on her, leaving her with a constant sense of inferiority.
“Am I… really someone this battalion needs?”
From official website
A Walking Tank pilot with silver hair and red eyes.
She seems to operate under Arimura’s orders, though which unit she belongs to remains unknown.
As a pilot, she possesses extraordinary skill and appears to command a squad of her own.
Her speech is polite, yet she constantly gives the impression of seeing through people’s hearts while looking down on them at the same time.
“Oh my, how unfortunate—it seems I’ve been disliked.”
From official website
Commander of the Hosokawa Imperial Guard Division, the central division of the Rokukyō Families in the Mizuho Imperial State.
Current head of the Hosokawa Family, one of the Rokukyō.
She serves as Supreme Commander of the “Northern Army”, organized in response to the second invasion by the Great Empire of Ivan.
Her intellectual and graceful manner befits her noble lineage.
On the battlefield, she demonstrates foresightful cunning and the decisiveness to carry it out, making her regarded as one of the Mizuho Imperial State’s foremost strategists.
During the First Mizuho–Ivan War three years earlier, she commanded the Hosokawa Imperial Guard Division.
She herself piloted one of the newly deployed Mechanical Armour of the Rokukyō Families, fighting on the front lines.
“When this war is over, I would like to share a drink with you, just the two of us.”
From official website
She constantly remains at Arimura’s side as her adjutant.
She also serves as deputy commander of the Rapid Response Modernization Brigade, issuing orders in Arimura’s place whenever she is unable to command.
A seasoned veteran, she is like an elder sister to Arimura and, in practice, the brigade’s field commander.
A disciplined warrior, she is tenacious and unyielding; combined with her stern features, these qualities lend her the bearing of an old samurai.
Her hobbies include the study of military history, and her specialty is traditional martial arts.
“Think it through, and then put it into words.”
From official website
Heir apparent of the Mouri Family, one of the Rokukyō.
If the Uesugi are known for military strength, the Mouri are renowned for diplomacy.
She serves as Chief of Staff of the Rapid Response Modernization Brigade and as captain of the experimental anti-metal airship Amanami.
By the nature of her duties, she sometimes becomes a confidant for the protagonist.
She is a mature figure, able to converse at her rank without pretension or malice.
Fully aware of the Mouri Family’s policy of prioritizing self-preservation, she acts with that principle in mind.
Her original unit, the Mouri Imperial Guard Division, was half-destroyed in the war against the Great Empire of Ivan three years earlier.
Since then, she has served under Arimura, conducting combat trials of the airship.
“Ah, that creaking hull… could it be a hole has opened?”
From official website
The heir of the Date family, one of the Rokukyō Families.
“Courage and recklessness are not the same.”
From official website
A member of the Date family and Yukiya’s younger sister.
“We do, at least, have confidence in our ability to judge people.”
From official website
The rightful heir of the Mizuho Clan.
From an early age, she has studied the art of rulership to become the next Kyōkō (Imperial Sovereign), ever conscious of her role as a public figure.
As a result, she is a girl of precocious thoughtfulness, constantly restraining herself.
For the sake of her people, she does not hesitate to embrace self-sacrifice.
Politically, much of her presence is “abstract”, yet she is revered by the citizens as the very symbol of the Mizuho Imperial State.
Although she speaks kindly to members of the Rokukyō Families, the complex web of power prevents her from crossing certain walls, leaving her with a sense of loneliness.
“Raise your head. I am Ruri, the 123rd Kyōkō.”
From official website
Commander of the Uesugi Imperial Guard Division—one of the central divisions of the Rokukyō—as well as the Capital Defence Division.
She is the current head of the Uesugi Family, one of the Rokukyō Families, and the mother of Yayoi.
With the Great Empire of Ivan launching its second invasion, she now serves as acting commander of the Ryōjun Fortress.
She is open-hearted and approachable, yet she exudes a sensual allure that is difficult to reconcile with that of a mother of one child.

However, she is a strict parent towards her daughter. At times, her words and actions reveal a readiness to pursue the prosperity of the Uesugi Family by any means necessary, creating tension between mother and child.
Three years ago, during the war, she distinguished herself in battle by using the Rokukyō Families’ Mechanical Armour.
In that conflict, having taken a liking to the protagonist, Ren permitted Hayakawa’s machine, Kotetsu, to bear the Sanskrit character of Bishamonten—the guardian deity of the Uesugi Family.
“…If you are a man, surely you understand?”
From official website
A member of the Eastern Expeditionary Army of the Great Empire of Ivan.
Her machine is a precision model with formidable armour, allowing no enemy to come close.
She favours the colour red so much that she even has her machine painted in it, making her an unmistakable sight on the battlefield.
Reckless and free-spirited, yet upholding the ideals of chivalry, she shows the greatest respect to her foes.
She is fascinated by Mizuho, and her favourite words are samurai and bushidō.
She has sworn absolute loyalty to her superior, Varvara, with whom she shares a deep bond of trust.
“I must at least know your name, pilot of the white machine.”
From official website
A member of the Ivan Empire’s Eastern Expeditionary Army.
The multi-legged T07-β she pilots may fall short of Mizuho’s machines in overall performance, yet its simplified design allows for heavier armour and far more efficient repairs.

Though young, she is a seasoned veteran who survived the war against the United Kingdom of Rimvon, with a remarkable ability to adapt to walking tanks. She is both capable and dependable, as well as a soldier of high calibre and a commander her subordinates can trust. On the other hand, she rarely opens her heart to others, which often makes her come across as condescending.
“Come now, show me what you’re made of!”
From official website
A top-class mercenary and the leader of the mercenary unit known as Blackwatch.
Her personal unit, Matilda, is a precision-type walker fitted with long-range cannons, giving her no blind spots and the versatility to handle virtually any battlefield with ease.

She is straightforward, pragmatic, and uncompromisingly realistic. As a mercenary, she will fight for either side, enemy or ally, so long as she is paid. Driven by a personal goal, she wanders across nations, well-versed in both the surface and the undercurrents of the world. She never shies away from criticizing the protagonist, who knows nothing beyond the military.
“Yesterday’s enemy is today’s ally. That’s the way of a mercenary.”
From official website
An unaffiliated mercenary.
She pilots the Valentine, a precision-type machine, and appears wherever there is a battle.
Her nature is cruel, cold-hearted, and selfish.
True to her own desires, she carries out vile acts without hesitation—a born warmonger.
As long as she is paid, she never questions right or wrong, and will not hesitate to turn her gun on women and children alike.
“What’s this? Turns out you’re more of a coward than I thought.”
From official website
A graceful lady with striking green eyes and blonde hair, whose origins and past are entirely unknown.
Approaching her out of mere curiosity would be extremely dangerous.
“I wonder how proper it is to answer a question with another question.”
From official website

segments.text: A daughter of the nobility from the Reitz Empire, one of the nations that make up the United Kingdom of Limvon.
She pilots the precision-type Walking Tank Schwert, modelled after Western knights.
Proud and high-handed, she possesses absolute confidence in both her combat ability and her command skills.
The armour she wears (a so-called bikini armour) is a venerable heirloom passed down through her family.
Despite its revealing appearance, it offers excellent impact resistance, and she wears it in a wide variety of situations.
…Though, deep down, she apparently finds the outfit just a little embarrassing.
“I suppose… I could acknowledge your worth, but only a little, if you insist!”
From official website
